scenes.title: Opening Theme Song
scenes.summary: Opening title song before Chun Yuqiao proposes a staffing solution at the Star Night meeting.

scenes.title: Three Shifts and Coffee
scenes.summary: Chun Yuqiao resolves the cross-department staffing dispute by putting Unit One on three shifts and trimming rival units' bonuses, then remarks that Bu Xiaogu's coffee is too weak.

scenes.title: Taking Over Studio Four
scenes.summary: Lin Jie leads the Studio One floor crew into Unit Two's studio under Chun Yuqiao's signed order, assigns one staffer per machine, and hands out lunch boxes to calm the room.

scenes.title: Taking Charge of Entertainment Talk
scenes.summary: Chun Yuqiao announces Unit One has taken over Unit Two's studio, silences objections with three months of poor ratings data, and adjourns while Kaiwen and Xingzi praise Lin Jie's nerve.

scenes.title: A Nearby Coffee Spot
scenes.summary: Qin Xiao greets fellow Media College graduate Chun Yuqiao outside the meeting room and asks to chat over coffee; Yuqiao points her to a nearby cafe lounge and excuses his weak stomach.

scenes.title: Deluxe Staff Meal
scenes.summary: Xiaoye cheers as Xin Huimei's fans crowdfund over a hundred percent of her contract penalty, and Kaiwen invites Bu Xiaogu to Unit One's steak-and-abalone meal before three shifts begin.

scenes.title: Crowdfunding the Penalty Fee
scenes.summary: Bu Xiaogu marvels at the huge sum raised online for Xin Huimei's contract buyout, and Xiaoye celebrates that Huimei has won her freedom before heading to lunch.

scenes.title: Xin Huimei on the Guest List
scenes.summary: Chun Yuqiao defends keeping Xin Huimei on the Star Night invitation list after her out-of-court settlement with Yuanye, assuring Qin Xiao he holds no personal grudge.

scenes.title: Recruiting Student Audience Members
scenes.summary: Tasked with returning to Media College to recruit front-row student audience members for Star Night at a hundred yuan per student, Qin Xiao agrees while noting students are harder to rally.

scenes.title: Working With Chun Yuqiao Is Best
scenes.summary: Over after-lunch chat, Xingzi and Xiaoye explain Unit One's fish-feast tradition, laugh when Bu Xiaogu calls Chun Yuqiao cute, and admit nobody wants to leave his team.

scenes.title: Running an Errand After Work
scenes.summary: Turned down by the student union, Qin Xiao summons Bu Xiaogu to take over recruiting college audience members after work while boasting of her evening meeting with Chun Yuqiao.

scenes.title: An Order Off the System
scenes.summary: Unit Two staff pressure Bu Xiaogu into carrying eight footage hard drives offsite without logging an official request, while Kaiwen and Xingzi urge Chun Yuqiao to head home early.
scenes.location: archive room and Unit One office

scenes.title: Leaking Footage Is Strictly Forbidden
scenes.summary: Chun Yuqiao stops Bu Xiaogu at the door with the bag of raw-footage drives, warns her that taking drives offsite without a logged order would make her look like a thief, and tells her to confront the culprits.

scenes.title: These Hard Drives Are Not Broken
scenes.summary: With Chun Yuqiao watching nearby, Bu Xiaogu confronts the Unit Two staffers, reveals the eight hard drives were never broken, and bluffs them into backing down.

scenes.title: Never Treat Admin Staff as Pawns
scenes.summary: Bu Xiaogu invokes the human-resources director as her boss, warns the schemers never again to use junior administrative staff as pawns, and makes them carry the drives back inside.

scenes.title: Complaints at the Lounge
scenes.summary: Waiting in vain for Chun Yuqiao at the neighbourhood lounge, Qin Xiao orders a drink and overhears Stella and rival department heads complaining bitterly about Unit One.

scenes.title: The After-Work Venting Spot
scenes.summary: At the lounge table, Xingtian managers gripe with Stella about Chun Yuqiao's authority until Qin Xiao diplomatically reassures everyone that she is only a fresh graduate listening and learning.

scenes.title: All the Students Are Lined Up
scenes.summary: Bu Xiaogu reports to Qin Xiao that she rode the subway two hours back to campus to line up the student audience, while Kaiwen and Xingzi warn of Unit Two's terrible red-carpet drafts.

scenes.title: I Came to Thank You
scenes.summary: Bu Xiaogu steps into Chun Yuqiao's office to thank him for saving her from the hard-drive trap, only to receive a brisk lecture about workplace boundaries and wasted time.

scenes.title: Bad Blood Between Red-Carpet Hosts
scenes.summary: Reviewing Unit Two's real red-carpet plan, Chun Yuqiao, Xingzi, and Kaiwen recall a notorious four-year feud between the two proposed commentators and demand a replacement.

scenes.title: This Plan Carries a Risk
scenes.summary: Kaiwen conveys Chun Yuqiao's warning against putting the feuding commentators onstage together, debates with Xingzi whether to press the issue, and hears Unit Two has agreed to switch hosts.
scenes.location: Unit Two office and Unit One desks

scenes.title: Media College Classmates Have Arrived
scenes.summary: As Wen Simo previews the Star Night red carpet, Bu Xiaogu guides her Media College classmates into the front cheering rows and Qin Xiao reports that everyone is in place.

scenes.title: The Wrong Sponsor Drink on Set
scenes.summary: Chun Yuqiao spots a competitor's bottled water placed by mistake on the Star Night press stage and directs Kaiwen and the floor crew to clear every bottle before cameras roll.
scenes.location: Star Night control room and stage

scenes.title: Saying One Thing and Doing Another
scenes.summary: Floor staff abruptly clear Bu Xiaogu's college classmates out of the front rows to make room for fan clubs, just as Kaiwen and Xingzi spot the two feuding commentators going live on the red carpet.

scenes.title: Buying Drinks to Apologize
scenes.summary: Bu Xiaogu spends seventeen hundred yuan of her own money on snacks and drinks to apologise to her upset Media College classmates after they were turned away on a weekend.
